page.overview:
What is Black Dragon Sword?

The Black Dragon Sword is a weapon that is used by Jarek in Mortal Kombat 4 and Mortal Kombat Gold.

The Black Dragon Sword as its name states, is a sword that belongs to the crime syndicate known as the Black Dragon. The sword bears a resemblance to either a falchion or a scimitar with its blade being single-edged and broad with spikes/serrations on the blade that resemble the ridges on the back of the dragon on the Mortal Kombat Logo.

The sword makes a return in MK Mobile as an Uncommon Equipment Card as well as being a Black Dragon Tower exclusive.
